$comment: Executable PR claims (Reality Control). scripts/detect-contradictions.mjs verifies refs exist on disk.

claims.assertion: Every command-center section either carries real rows or an explicit available:false; the governing policy always shows its SOURCE, and a fallback source renders a visible warning banner with the exact operator remedy.
Kill-switch toggles publish a new policy version through the existing versioned path; the UI never fakes a toggle - a persistence failure surfaces as an error toast.
